sloka: मुहूर्तं चिन्तयामास मार्गमात्मसुखावहम् ।सा सुहृच्चार्थकामा च तं निशम्य सुनिश्चयम् ॥२-१०-४॥
transliteration: muhūrtaṁ cintayāmāsa mārgamātmasukhāvaham ।sā suhṛccārthakāmā ca taṁ niśamya suniścayam ॥2-10-4॥

translations.english: Manthara, Kaikeyi's friend, too, driven by a strong desire to fulfil her resolve was highly pleased and on hearing the firm determination of Kaikeyi, felt as if the accomplishment of the objective was at hand.
translations.hindi: कैकेयी के ऐसा कहने पर महाराज दशरथ, मुहूते भर बिकल हो, तदनन्तर कुट्ट हो बोले
